headline: Airtel becomes India's most valuable brand; PM Modi urges industry to focus on domestic manufacturing and employment.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Airtel overtakes HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand according to a new report
PM Modi criticizes industry for high import reliance and static wage growth
Tata Trusts clarifies that a Tata Sons listing is not on the agenda for its board meeting
Regulators from RBI and IRDAI flag concerns over bank mis-selling and consumer data privacy
whatHappening: Airtel has surpassed HDFC Bank in brand value, claiming the top spot in India
The Prime Minister has called for industry leaders to improve manufacturing standards and domestic demand
SEBI and PFRDA are advocating for deeper capital markets to support the Viksit Bharat 2047 vision
RBI officials have linked financial mis-selling directly to aggressive sales targets at the branch level
summary: Airtel has overtaken HDFC Bank as India's most valuable brand. PM Modi has urged industry leaders to prioritize domestic manufacturing and employment. Regulators are focusing on market depth and addressing concerns over mis-selling and data privacy.
